controls.title: Unified Engagement Mode (UEM)
controls.desc:
Engage lateral and longitudinal control with cruise control engagement.

Note: Once lateral control is engaged via UEM, it will remain engaged until it is manually disabled via the MADS button or car shut off.

controls.title: Steering Mode on Brake Pedal
controls.desc: Choose how Automatic Lane Centering (ALC) behaves after the brake pedal is manually pressed in sunnypilot.

options.name: Remain Active
options.desc: Remain Active: ALC will remain active when the brake pedal is pressed.

options.name: Pause
options.desc: Pause: ALC will pause when the brake pedal is pressed.

options.name: Disengage
options.desc: Disengage: ALC will disengage when the brake pedal is pressed.

descriptions.no_car:

Choose how Automatic Lane Centering (ALC) behaves after the brake pedal is manually pressed in sunnypilot.

controls.title: Auto Lane Change by Blinker
controls.desc:
Set a timer to delay the auto lane change operation when the blinker is used. No nudge on the steering wheel is required to auto lane change if a timer is set. Default is Nudge.

Please use caution when using this feature. Only use the blinker when traffic and road conditions permit.

controls.title: Auto Lane Change: Delay with Blind Spot
controls.desc: Toggle to enable a delay timer for seamless lane changes when blind spot monitoring (BSM) detects a obstructing vehicle, ensuring safe maneuvering.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Auto lane change timer must be nudgeless or greater than 0s

controls.title: Pause Lateral Control with Blinker
controls.desc: Pause lateral control with blinker when traveling below the desired speed selected.

controls.title: Minimum Speed for Blinker Pause
controls.desc: Speed below which lateral control will pause when blinker is active

controls.title: Enforce Torque Lateral Control
controls.desc: Enable this to enforce sunnypilot to steer with Torque lateral control.

descriptions.angle_steering: This vehicle uses angle-based steering and cannot use torque control.
descriptions.nnlc_active: Neural Network Lateral Control is enabled. Disable NNLC to use torque control.
descriptions.default: Enable this to enforce sunnypilot to steer with Torque lateral control.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires Neural Network Lateral Control to be disabled

controls.title: Self-Tune
controls.desc: Enables self-tune for Torque lateral control for platforms that do not use Torque lateral control by default.

controls.title: Less Restrict Settings for Self-Tune (Beta)
controls.desc: Less strict settings when using Self-Tune. This allows torqued to be more forgiving when learning values.

controls.title: Neural Network Lateral Control (NNLC)
controls.desc:
Formerly known as "NNFF", this replaces the lateral "torque" controller with one using a neural network trained on each car's (actually, each separate EPS firmware) driving data for increased controls accuracy.

Reach out to the sunnypilot team in the following channel at the sunnypilot Discord server with feedback, or to provide log data for your car if your car is currently unsupported: #tuning-nnlc

descriptions.check_compatibility:
